messages:
jen: Starting preflight for py/ts SDK cutover in 15m. I'm planning to publish canary -> QA -> GA across cohorts. Please confirm pin policy for apps that rely on sync client.
chris: ack. what's the plan for dist-tag and republish if signatures drift?
jen: plan: canary tag "ci-canary", then after 30m smoke, promote to "next", then GA "latest". If we see checksum mismatch we yank and republish. No auto-retag.
sandeep: please ensure publish uses ephemeral tokens and we update internal vendored shim before GA. Also request a dep pin on monorepo for 24h to avoid drift :eyes: 
maya: test matrix: py37/38/39 on linux and mac; ts node16/18. My job queue is clear.
jen: ok. trigger in 10m. @deploy-bot will run publishing. If tests fail we roll back and re-tag.
deploy-bot: [INFO] starting publish for packages: @redwood/sdk-py, @redwood/sdk-ts
deploy-bot: [CMD] npm publish packages/sdk-ts --tag ci-canary
chris: note: do not auto-update changelog on GA tag; we will cut manual changelog after compile step
olivia: I'll monitor console for client telemetry spikes and latency regressions
maya: smoke passed on py wheels. saw one flake on mac, rerunning.
jen: hold GA until we decide on sync client deprecation message. If we finalize, we'll include deprecation note in release notes.
sandeep: propose: soft-deprecate old sync client, add migration guide link in release notes and in SDK warnings for 30 days.
jen: agreed. we'll include CX note and optional env var to silence warning.
deploy-bot: [SUCCESS] canary publish complete: sdk-ts@3.2.0-canary.2026.03.21, sdk-py 3.2.0rc1
chris: running integration tests against canary now.
maya: ts tests green. py tests green except one intermittent related to auth header normalization.
jen: let's proceed with "next" promotion in 25m if no more errors.
sandeep: also add a pinned dependency in internal monorepo: sdk@3.2.0-next for 24h. I'll open a PR.
jen: opening shiproom thread for GA cut next week. For now, retreat if any checksum drift or signer mismatch.
deploy-bot: [WARNING] registry responded with 409 on sdk-py wheel upload - checksum mismatch. pausing automated promote.
jen: pausing. @chris can you inspect pipeline artifacts?
chris: looking. seems an intermittent s3 replication lag. re-uploading wheel now.
deploy-bot: [INFO] reattempt upload...
deploy-bot: [SUCCESS] wheel uploaded. canary artifacts stable.
jen: thanks. moving forward with "next" promote in 5m unless any objections.
olivia: monitoring production routes, no traffic to canary tenants.
maya: running final smoke on mac again.
deploy-bot: [SUCCESS] promoted sdk-ts@3.2.0-next
jen: ok pinned plan executed. please don't auto-merge any dep bump PRs for 24h. I'll post release notes draft shortly.
chris: noted. tagging changelog and opening release PR.
jen: done. release notes draft: includes deprecation, migration guide, canary/next/GA flow, rollback instructions.
maya: lgtm :thumbsup:
sandeep: lgtm. I'll merge pinned dep PR after GA cutoff window closes.
jen: thanks everyone. I'll update the slack if any rollbacks. end.
